trap.uz: Davomiy shaklda ishlatilmaydi: 'I am not understanding' NOTO'G'RI.

ex: I think it's a good idea.

trap.uz: 'What means this?' NOTO'G'RI — 'What does this mean?'
'I feel myself good' NOTO'G'RI — 'I feel good/well'.

ex: She isn't here at the moment.
I'm studying a lot these days.

trap.uz: 'say ME' EMAS — 'say TO me' yoki 'tell me'. O'tgan zamon /sed/ deb o'qiladi.
'tell' dan keyin darhol shaxs keladi: 'tell me'.

ex: Put the book on the table.

trap.uz: 'How much costs it?' NOTO'G'RI — 'How much does it cost?'

ex: Do you have a bigger size?

trap.uz: Olmosh o'rtaga tushadi: 'try IT on' — 'try on it' EMAS.

ex: The shop has a lot of customers.
He wears a suit to work.
He is wearing a blue tie.

trap.uz: Sondan keyin ko'plik yo'q: 'two thousand', 'two thousands' EMAS.

ex: Don't say someone is fat — it isn't polite.

trap.uz: Odam haqida 'fat' deyish qo'pol; 'big' yoki 'large' muloyimroq.

ex: He is a handsome young man.

trap.uz: Faqat erkaklar uchun; ayollar uchun 'beautiful' yoki 'pretty'. 'd' o'qilmaydi.

ex: The blonde woman is my teacher.
He grew a beard last year.

trap.uz: Doim ko'plik: 'a glasses' EMAS — 'a pair of glasses'.

ex: She is a very kind person.

trap.uz: '-ly' bo'lsa ham bu SIFAT, ravish emas.
'quiet' (jim) va 'quite' (ancha) — imlosi juda o'xshash, ma'nosi butunlay boshqa.

ex: Don't be lazy — do your homework.
To be honest, I don't like it.
My father is angry with me.
She is worried about the exam.

trap.uz: 'What does he look like?' — tashqi ko'rinish; 'What is he like?' — xarakter.

ex: She is a very nice person.

trap.uz: 'whose' (kimning) va 'who's' (= who is) — talaffuzi bir xil, ma'nosi boshqa.

ex: Our house is small but comfortable.
We moved to Tashkent last year.

trap.uz: 'before three years' EMAS — 'three years ago' (so'z tartibi teskari).

ex: First we ate, then we walked.

trap.uz: 'I am bored' = zerikyapman; 'I am boring' = men zerikarliman.

ex: She was glad about the news.

trap.uz: 'arrive TO' EMAS — kichik joy uchun 'arrive at', shahar/mamlakat uchun 'arrive in'.

ex: She left her bag on the bus.
She returned the book to the library.

trap.uz: Sanalmaydi va BIRLIK: 'The news IS good', 'a news' EMAS.

ex: I got a letter from my aunt.
How many letters are in this word?
